name: Redwood National and State Parks
description: Along 37 miles of northern California's Pacific coast, this group of one national and three state parks shelters about 45 percent of the world's remaining old-growth coast redwoods, the tallest trees on Earth. Walking among them, you pass through misty forest with towering trunks, then reach wild beaches where sea lions haul out and bald eagles and rare brown pelicans fly overhead.
